findings.title: N-able N-central '4EverAble2Shell' Account Takeover
findings.summary: Authentication bypass vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated attackers to take over administrative accounts.

findings.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Guest-to-Host Execution
findings.summary: A flaw in the client allows unauthorized file transfer and execution during active remote sessions.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server mod_http2 RCE
findings.summary: A heap corruption vulnerability in the mod_http2 module of Apache HTTP Server allows for remote code execution.

findings.title: Cisco BroadWorks XML External Entity (XXE)
findings.summary: An XML parsing vulnerability in the Open Client Interface allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read sensitive configuration data.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler Memory Overflow
findings.summary: A memory overflow in packet processing can cause unpredictable behavior or a Denial of Service.

findings.title: MongoDB Server Pre-Auth Remote Code Execution
findings.summary: A pre-authentication use-after-free vulnerability in the replication component can lead to server crashes or arbitrary code execution.

findings.title: Zoom Workplace Privilege Escalation
findings.summary: Two vulnerabilities in Zoom Workplace for Windows allow unauthenticated users to escalate privileges via network access.
